config.EnableThisMod.name: Enable the mod.
config.EnableThisMod.description: On/Off setting of this mod itself.
config.section.S_1stArea.name: 1st Additional Area Setting
config.section.S_1stArea.description: This is a setting item related to the first additional area accessible from the vanilla farm cave.
config.OpenImmediately.name: Immediate Open
config.OpenImmediately.description: Originally, they are opened when the conditions are cleared, but checking this item will allow you to enter additional areas immediately.
config.AvoidCertainBugs.name: (Notes) Avoid certain bugs.
config.AvoidCertainBugs.description: This option will be removed in an upcoming update, and any rooms that had this option enabled will disappear. If you have this option ON, please collect the items in your current room and disable it. Rooms that you can enter with this option disabled will continue to be used. The totem bug is not currently occurring, so please rest assured. (The following text is the previous description for this item. "There was a bug up to v1.3 where warp totems would appear on the collectibles in front of the dusty chapel and would not disappear. If you have this condition, please turn on this item. A word of caution! If you turn this item ON, the cave will be created as a different MAP, although it looks the same. If you have placed valuable items in the cave, please remove them before changing the settings.")
config.section.S_2ndArea.name: 2nd Additional Area Setting
config.section.S_2ndArea.description: These are the settings for the second additional area, which can be accessed from the first additional area.
config.OpenImmediately_2nd.name: Immediate Open
config.OpenImmediately_2nd.description: Originally, they are opened when the conditions are cleared, but checking this item will allow you to enter additional areas immediately.
config.2ndArea_Minecart.name: Install Minecart
config.2ndArea_Minecart.description: Enabling this setting will install minecart in the second additional area. You must have visited the second additional area at least once for minecart to appear as a destination.
config.section.S_KisaaFCP.name: Below are the settings when using^Kisaa's Farm Cave Pack mod
config.section.S_KisaaFCP.description: The settings must be exactly the same as the settings in the Kisaa's Farm Cave Pack mod. If the settings are not exactly the same, unexpected patching may occur and display problems may occur. (If the cave type is "Fantasy", the entrance is shown on the right side of the cave.)
